Notes for the first week.
\section{Groups}
A group is a set $G$ with an associative operation, an identity and inverses.
$$ (ab)c = a(bc) $$
\section{Subgroups}
$H \le G$ when $H$ is closed under the operation and inverses.
\subsection{Cosets}
The cosets $gH$ partition $G$, so $|G| = [G:H]\,|H|$.
